entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
Issues

  • Hot reload crashes with "An item with the same key has already been added. Key: 0" editing an async method with captures and an await in catch/finally #86237
  • Language server: deleting many source files stalls every request that needs the project's compilation, about 1 s per deleted file #86236

Closed

    18.13
